title: I Just Bought $8,100 of 4 Stocks. Here’s Why
creator: Couch Investor
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: Couch Investor's weekly portfolio update: the portfolio rose 2.33% on the week and is up 15.4% year to date against the S&P 500's 10.6%, but fell 14.31% over the past month versus the S&P's 1.16% decline. He added $8,100 across four names and previews a busy earnings week headlined by Nvidia on Tuesday after the close, where he expects about $108.7 billion of revenue, up 98% year on year, and watches whether FY28 guidance is raised from at least 70% to 75-80% growth. He also runs through the week's other reporters (Home Depot, Disney, JD, Target, Walmart, Alibaba, Palo Alto) and the prediction-market odds for Nvidia's next CEO, led by Arm's Rene Haas at 27% and CUDA inventor Ian Buck at 23%, with interim CEO Colette Kress at 10% and Jensen Huang himself at 9%, noting an online letter signed by over 100,000 people calling for Huang's return. Calls: MU BUY at $714 (added 4 shares), BUY reiterated; RKLB BUY at ~$59 (added 30 shares), BUY reiterated; NVDA BUY at $178, flipped from UNCERTAIN, on 13.5x forward earnings after a 32.3% drawdown; AXON BUY at $312, BUY reiterated; RDDT HOLD, flipped from UNCERTAIN, with no adding until a catalyst. Also discussed without new calls: GOOGL (cheap, wants a close above $300), SOFI, AMZN, META and NBIS (still extremely bullish but no moves until after Nvidia earnings), and CRWV, where he holds January 2028 $100 calls. (Auto-captions garble 'Jensen Huang' as 'Jensen Wong' and 'Colette Kress' as 'Colet Crest'.)
